title.narrative: Supporting small and medium-sized manufacturers in the automotive component industry in India: Deepening and widening the services provided within the framework of the UNIDO-ACMA-DHI Partnership Progr

description.narrative: UNIDO has been implementing a programme "UNIDO-ACMA-DHI Partnership Programme for Automotive Industry [Phase I] (SAP ID: 100245) since 2014. This proposed concept is for the second phase of the partnership programme supporting tier 2 or lower suppliers in the automotive industry in India in terms of quality, productivity, resource efficiency, innovation etc. in partnership with the Automotive Component Manufacturers Association of India (ACMA).
